name: Oil (Brent)
summary: Brent near $97 on 9 Nov after Trump called new Iran attacks unlikely; ships still being hit near Hormuz
state: Brent was near $97.4 early on 9 Nov, down 6% on the week and 8.7% on the month, inside the $85–110 Watch band (Yahoo Finance). Prices slipped after President Trump said new attacks on Iran were highly unlikely while talks progress, despite further ship attacks near Hormuz (Asharq Al-Awsat). No new outage above 2 mb/d was confirmed this run.
for_you: Oil prices feed into petrol, diesel, heating oil and transport costs, usually within weeks. Prices remain well above the Normal band, so that pressure persists even after the recent fall.
rubric_hit: Brent $97.4 in the $85–110 Watch band; 1-month change −8.7%

sources.title: Asharq Al-Awsat — Oil falls as Trump says new Iran attacks 'unlikely'

why: Oil feeds inflation, transport and household budgets; price spikes have preceded most post-war recessions.
drivers: OPEC+ output, Middle East supply risk, sanctions, demand, inventories, shipping disruption.

rubric.alert: Brent > $110, or 1-month change > +30%, or a major physical supply outage (> 2 mb/d).
